paragraphs.source_en: “Do you hear the gentleman, Charlotte?” thundered Mr. Claypole.
“Yes, Noah, dear!” replied Mrs. Bolter, extending her hand.

units.source_en: replied Mrs. Bolter, extending her hand.

paragraphs.source_en: “She calls me Noah, as a sort of fond way of talking,” said Mr. Morris Bolter, late Claypole, turning to Fagin. “You understand?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh yes, I understand—perfectly,” replied Fagin, telling the truth for once. “Goodnight! Goodnight!”

units.source_en: “Oh yes, I understand—perfectly,” replied Fagin, telling the truth for once.

paragraphs.source_en: With many adieus and good wishes, Mr. Fagin went his way. Noah Claypole, bespeaking his good lady’s attention, proceeded to enlighten her relative to the arrangement he had made, with all that haughtiness and air of superiority, becoming, not only a member of the sterner sex, but a gentleman who appreciated the dignity of a special appointment on the kinchin lay, in London and its vicinity.
